Name: Fast
Description: Fast rad.

Name: Extra
Description: Improve lighting quality by doing 9 point oversampling.

Name: Bounce
Description: Set the number of radiosity light bounces.

Name: Ambient
Description: Set ambient world light, as R G B (0.0 to 1.0 each).
Warning: Pass as three space-separated values, e.g. 0.1 0.1 0.1

Name: Vismatrix
Description: Set the vismatrix method: normal, sparse, or off.

Name: Pre-25th Anniversary
Description: Optimize the compile for the pre-Half-Life 25th Anniversary Update engine.

Name: Limiter
Description: Set the light clipping threshold (-1 = none).

Name: Circus
Description: Debug mode: sets unlit direct-lighting pixels to a random fullbright color to help locate unlit lightmaps.
Warning: Debugging aid, not for final compiles.

Name: No Spread
Description: Disable sunlight spread angles for this compile.

Name: No Opaque Entities
Description: Disable the opaque zhlt_lightflags for this compile.

Name: No Studio Shadow
Description: Disable opaque studiomodels; ignores zhlt_studioshadow for this compile.

Name: Smooth
Description: Set the smoothing threshold for blending, in degrees.

Name: Smooth2
Description: Set the smoothing threshold between different textures.

Name: Chop
Description: Set the radiosity patch size for normal textures.

Name: Texchop
Description: Set the radiosity patch size for texture-light faces.

Name: No Tex Scale
Description: Do not scale radiosity patches with texture scale.

Name: Coring
Description: Set the lighting threshold before blackness.

Name: Direct Light
Description: Set the direct lighting threshold.

Name: No Lerp
Description: Disable radiosity interpolation, using nearest point instead.

Name: Fade
Description: Set the global fade. Larger values make lights shorter.

Name: Texlight Gap
Description: Set the global gap distance for texlights.

Name: Scale
Description: Set the global light scaling value.

Name: Gamma
Description: Set the global gamma value.

Name: Sky
Description: Set the ambient sunlight contribution in the shade outside.

Name: Lights File
Description: Manually specify a lights.rad file to use.

Name: No Sky Fix
Description: Disable light_environment being global.

Name: Incremental
Description: Use or create an incremental transfer list file.

Name: Colour Gamma
Description: Sets different gamma values for R, G, B.
Warning: Pass as three space-separated values, e.g. 1.0 1.0 1.0

Name: Colour Scale
Description: Sets different lightscale values for R, G, B.
Warning: Pass as three space-separated values, e.g. 1.0 1.0 1.0

Name: Colour Jitter
Description: Adds noise, independent per colour channel, for dithering.

Name: Jitter
Description: Adds monochromatic noise, for dithering.

Name: Custom Shadow With Bounce
Description: Enables custom shadows with bounce light.

Name: RGB Transfers
Description: Enables RGB transfers (for custom shadows).

Name: Min Light
Description: Minimum final light level (integer from 0 to 255).

Name: Compress
Description: Compress transfer (0=32bit, 1=16bit, 2=8bit).

Name: RGB Compress
Description: Compress RGB transfer (0=96bit, 1=48bit, 2=32bit, 3=24bit).

Name: Soft Sky
Description: Smooth skylight (0=off, 1=on).

Name: Depth
Description: Thickness of translucent objects.

Name: Block Opaque
Description: Remove the black areas around opaque entities (0=off, 1=on).

Name: No Textures
Description: Don't load textures.

Name: Tex Reflect Gamma
Description: Gamma that relates reflectivity to texture color bits.

Name: Tex Reflect Scale
Description: Reflectivity for a 255-white texture.

Name: Blur
Description: Enlarge the lightmap sample to blur the lightmap. Softens GoldSrc's blocky shadow edges.

Name: Blur Clamp
Description: Limit blurred light bleeding into shadow edges (0 = off, 0.0 to 1.0).

Name: No Bleed Fix
Description: Don't fix the wall-bleeding problem for large blur values.

Name: No Emitter Range
Description: Don't fix pointy texlights.

Name: PCF
Description: PCF taps per axis for softer shadow edges (1 = off, 1 to 8). Cost scales with the square of this value.

Name: Ambient Occlusion
Description: Enable ambient occlusion (cosine-weighted hemisphere).

Name: AO Scale
Description: Set the ambient occlusion ray length. Larger values give thicker, wider bands.

Name: AO Gain
Description: Set the ambient occlusion falloff exponent. Larger values give sharper corners; smaller values give softer spread.

Name: AO Level
Description: Set the ambient occlusion hemisphere sampling level (1 to 8). Lower values compile faster at the same quality.

Name: AO Min Weight
Description: Skip ambient occlusion rays below this weight fraction (0.0 to 0.1).

Name: AO Studio Mode
Description: Global zhlt_shadowmode override for ambient occlusion only: fast, normal, slow, or inherit.

Name: AO Opacity
Description: Set the ambient occlusion opacity (0.0 to 1.0).

Name: AO Color
Description: Set the ambient occlusion tint color, as R G B (0 to 255).
Warning: SDHLT-specific parameter. Pass as three space-separated values.

Name: AO Stats
Description: Print ambient occlusion ray/stage statistics after BuildFaceLights.

Name: Waddir
Description: Search this folder for WAD files.

Name: Dump
Description: Dumps light patches to a file for HLRAD debugging.

Name: Draw Patch
Description: Export light patch positions to file 'mapname_patch.pts'.

Name: Draw Sample
Description: Export light sample positions in an area to file 'mapname_sample.pts'.
Warning: Pass as: x y z r

Name: Draw Edge
Description: Export smooth edge positions to file 'mapname_edge.pts'.

Name: Draw Lerp
Description: Show bounce light triangulation status.

Name: Draw Nudge
Description: Show nudged samples.

Name: Draw Overload
Description: Highlight fullbright spots.

Name: Texdata
Description: Alter the maximum texture memory limit, in KB.

Name: Lightdata
Description: Alter the maximum lighting memory limit, in KB.

Name: Chart
Description: Display BSP statistics.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLRAD as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLRAD as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: No Log
Description: Don't generate the compile logfiles.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually specify the number of CPU threads to run.

Name: Estimate
Description: Display estimated time remaining during compile.

Name: Verbose
Description: Compile with verbose messages.

Name: No Info
Description: Do not show tool configuration information.

Name: Developer
Description: Compile with developer messages.

Name: Console
Description: Set to 0 to turn off the tool's pop-up console window (default is 1).
